tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Lists the CFTC markets COT-Reports covers (350+): CFTC code, ticker, name, exchange, category and which report families exist for each. Filter by a search text, a category or a report family. Available at every level.

tools.name: get_latest_snapshot
tools.description: The latest Legacy COT report of every market, 100 markets per answer (use offset for the next page): net positions of large speculators and commercials, their week-on-week change, and open interest. Filter by category. Available at every level. Both CFTC variants (Futures Only and Futures & Options

tools.name: get_latest_positions
tools.description: The latest COT report for one market: long, short and net positions of every trader group, the week-on-week change, % of open interest. Without an account and with a free account: the Legacy report. COT Premium and Data API keys: every report family (Legacy, Disaggregated, TFF, Supplemental); COT Pr

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Weekly COT history for one market, newest first: open interest and the net position of every trader group (up to 260 reports per call; page back with "until"). Without an account: Legacy, the last 26 reports (6 months). Free account: Legacy, the last 520 reports (10 years). COT Premium and Data API

tools.name: get_cot_index
tools.description: The COT index (0–100: where the current net position sits between its lowest and highest of the lookback window) for large speculators and commercials, from the Legacy report. Without an account: the 26- and 52-week windows; a free account, COT Premium and a Data API key: every window. Both CFTC var

tools.name: scan_extremes
tools.description: Markets where large speculators are crowded long or short this week (the Crowding score: a blend of the 26-, 52- and 156-week percentiles of their net position as % of open interest; crowded long from 80 until it falls below 75, crowded short from 20 until it rises above 25), from the Legacy Futures

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.description: The weekly summary of the 35 main markets (currencies, crypto, metals, energy, agriculture, stock indices) from the latest Legacy report: net positions of speculators and commercials and their change. Available at every level. Both CFTC variants (Futures Only and Futures & Options Combined) with COT

tools.name: get_release_schedule
tools.description: Which COT report is the latest, when it was published, and when the next one is due (the CFTC publishes on Fridays at 3:30 pm Eastern for the Tuesday before; holidays move it). Available at every level.

tools.name: explain_cot
tools.description: A short explanation of a COT concept — the trader groups, net positions, open interest, the four report families, the COT index, release timing — with a link to the full guide. Available at every level.
